name: Mads Christensen
bio:
Mads Christensen’s career began in advertising, crafting campaigns for major Danish brands before a lifelong passion for motorsport drew him towards the track. He started small, volunteering at local racing events and eventually landing a marketing role with a junior formula team. Over the years, he honed his skills, learning the intricacies of motorsport marketing, from sponsor acquisition to fan engagement. At RFK Racing, Mads approaches his role with a blend of data-driven analysis and creative flair, always seeking new and innovative ways to build brand awareness and drive commercial success.

Mads believes in fostering strong relationships with sponsors and fans alike, understanding that their support is crucial for the team's long-term success. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to think strategically, even in the most chaotic race-day environments. His distinctive approach lies in his deep understanding of both the business and the passion that fuels motorsport, allowing him to craft marketing campaigns that resonate with a wide audience.

His deep network in the European racing scene and experience with global brands makes him an invaluable asset to RFK Racing's international expansion plans.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight side part.
physical.description: Mads is a man of medium build with a distinguished, slightly weathered face that reflects his years of experience.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with marketing ideas.
Drinks copious amounts of black coffee throughout the day.
Has a habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
